facts.value: The International Office of Economics is the central contact point for all students of the department with questions about international topics. It particularly advises students on organizing a study abroad and supports guests from foreign partner universities during their studies in Frankfurt.

International students receive an easier start at Goethe University and in Frankfurt through a Frankfurt Buddy. Experienced students provide support in navigating the campus, studies, and life in Frankfurt while also allowing for intercultural and linguistic exchange. The goal is to ease the start of international students into Frankfurt student life and offer all participants the chance to meet interesting new people from various countries.
The Equality Council of the Department of Economics offers an English course for administrative staff (m/f/d) during the lecture period. If interested in participating in the course, please email.
